claims.claim: SGLang Checkpoint Engine distributes model weight loading across multiple processes and nodes and can overlap loading with initialization tasks such as CUDA Graph capture.
Checkpoint Engine supports Broadcast, P2P and combined All update methods.
The documented startup path uses dummy model loading and checkpoint-engine-wait-weights-before-ready, then sends weights to /update_weights_from_ipc.
The update endpoint requires the server admin API key and the checkpoint update script uses admin_auth_headers.
SGLang checkpoint worker extension maps device UUIDs to IPC handles and exposes model loader and post-load hook callbacks.
Server-side IPC weight updates flow through SchedulerWeightUpdaterManager and use a control-request barrier after runner updates.
The runner's IPC updater rejects unsafe active weight-cache states and delegates tensor receipt to the checkpoint-engine worker extension.

Checkpoint engine loading should be evaluated as a full startup critical path, including storage, transfer and post-load processing rather than assuming parallel loading always improves readiness time.
claims.locator: Documented parallel load and initialization overlap; performance boundary is derived engineering guidance
